# HKEx Filing Scraper

> Scrape and ingest HKEx (Hong Kong Stock Exchange) regulatory filings — 25+ years of
> announcements and disclosures — into PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, MongoDB, Neo4j,
> ClickHouse, DuckDB, or SurrealDB, with full-text extraction from PDF/HTML/Excel, structured
> tables, coverage tracking, and optional graph linking. This is the documentation site for
> the `hkex-filing-scraper` Python package.

## Getting started

- [Home](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/): what the project is and where to start.
- [What's new](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/news/): dated release notes, newest first.
- [Getting started](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/getting-started/): install, quick start, and first run.
- [Configuration](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/configuration/): every environment variable and the `DATABASE_TARGET` sink selector.
- [CLI](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/cli/): command-line reference and flags.
- [MCP server](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/mcp/): a read-only Model Context Protocol server over stdio for LLM clients.
- [Live MCP gateway](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/live-mcp/): a hosted, database-free Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint that fetches live HKEx data; no API key.
- [AI agent support](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/ai-agents/): connect the gateway from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini, opencode, Manus, and Perplexity.

## Database sinks

- [Overview](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/sinks/): support matrix, capabilities, and popularity order.
- [PostgreSQL](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/sinks/postgresql/), [MySQL / MariaDB](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/sinks/mysql/), [SQLite](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/sinks/sqlite/), [MongoDB](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/sinks/mongodb/), [Neo4j](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/sinks/neo4j/), [ClickHouse](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/sinks/clickhouse/), [DuckDB](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/sinks/duckdb/), [SurrealDB](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/sinks/surrealdb/): per-engine setup, upserts, and notes.

## Decisions (ADRs)

- [ADR 0001 — Versioning](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/adr/0001-versioning-and-release-automation/): git-tag-as-version via hatch-vcs.
- [ADR 0002 — Multi-sink](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/adr/0002-multi-sink-architecture/): one scraper, many databases.
- [ADR 0003 — Support policy](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/adr/0003-sink-support-policy/): open source first.
- [ADR 0004 — Publish to PyPI](https://hkex-listco-updates.ascent-partners.com/adr/0004-publish-to-pypi-trusted-publishing/): Trusted Publishing; GitHub Packages rejected.
